games.title: What Comes Next?

games.instructions_en: Associate the illustrated mail envelope with the correct Amharic word: 'ፖስታ'
games.tips_en: Tip: ፖስታ (pronounced 'Posta') means Envelope or Mail.

games.title: Master Challenge: Multi-Form Skip

games.instructions_en: Listen closely to the complex pronunciation blend. Which symbol represents the exact sound you hear?

games.title: Master Challenge: Word Finish
games.instructions_en: Look at the incomplete word for 'Papaya' fruit: ፓ[ ? ]ያ. What is the missing middle letter?
games.tips_en: The full word is ፓፓያ (pronounced Pa-pa-ya).

games.title: Master Challenge: Shape Decoder
games.instructions_en: Final Boss Question! Match the native English phonetic spelling 'PIE' with its correct Amharic 5th form character counterpart.
